integrity: Original distribution attributed to its published authors; general weighted-Poisson underdispersion is prior art. The new exact unique global minimum and zero-ratio calibration are stated and proved with a standalone coefficient certificate; numerical brackets use exact rational bounds.
scientific_limitations: Population theorem for the unmodified one-parameter semi-Poisson law only; no claim about empirical model rankings, arbitrary mixtures or zero-inflated variants. Historical priority beyond inspected literature remains unverified.
title: Sharp dispersion minimum and zero-deflation law for the semi-Poisson count family
